name: mail2telegram-cloudflare
description: Mail2Telegram ported to Cloudflare Workers: poll IMAP mailboxes on a schedule, keep state in KV, forward mail to Telegram.

TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.description: Chat id that receives normal mail. Send the bot a message, then read `message.chat.id` from `https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates`.

MAILBOXES.description: JSON array of mailboxes, for example `[{"email":"you@gmail.com","password":"app-password","host":"imap.gmail.com","port":993}]`. Use an app password / authorization code, not your normal login password.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Long random token that protects `/status`, `/run`, `/telegram/test`, and the dashboard. It can only be changed in Cloudflare.

SETTINGS_KEY.description: 32-byte encryption key for saving settings from the dashboard. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Keep it in Cloudflare only; changing it makes existing dashboard settings unreadable.
